llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM加工TiAl合金的基板预热效应，未涉及生物医用植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与用户研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants; focus is on high-temperature TiAl alloy for non-biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究基板预热对SLM成形TiAl合金织构、相组成和纳米硬度的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用不同预热温度的SLM实验，结合XRD、EBSD和纳米压痕表征
summary_zh.result: 预热温度显著影响织构强度、相分布和纳米硬度，提高预热可减弱织构并增加硬度
summary_zh.validation: 通过XRD、EBSD和纳米压痕实验验证了预热效果

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how substrate preheating influences the crystallographic texture, phase composition, and nanohardness of a Ti-45Al-2Cr-5Nb alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was performed at different preheating temperatures, and the samples were characterized using XRD, EBSD, and nanoindentation.
summary_en.result: Substrate preheating significantly affected the texture intensity, phase distribution, and nanohardness; higher preheating reduced texture and increased nanohardness.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements from XRD, EBSD, and nanoindentation confirmed the effects of preheating on microstructure and mechanical properties.

papers.title: A carboxymethyl chitosan and peptide-decorated polyetheretherketone ternary biocomposite with enhanced antibacterial activity and osseointegration as orthopedic/dental implants.
papers.abstract: Carbon fiber-reinforced polyetheretherketone (CFRPEEK) possesses biomechanical properties such as elastic modulus similar to human bones and is becoming a dominant alternative to replace the traditional metallic implants. The defective osseointegration and bacterial infection risk of CFRPEEK, however, impede its clinical adoption. In the current study, a newly-developed carbon fiber-reinforced polyetheretherketone/nanohydroxyapatite (CFRPEEK/n-HA) ternary biocomposite was functionalized by covalently grafting carboxymethyl chitosan (CMC) followed by the decoration of a bone-forming peptide (BFP) assisted via the polydopamine tag strategy. Antibacterial test with Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) indicated that the CMC and peptide-conjugated substrates (pep-CMC-CFRPEEK/n-HA) significantly suppressed bacterial adhesion. In vitro cell attachment/growth, spreading assay, alkaline phosphatase activity, real-time PCR analysis, osteogenesis-related protein expression and calcium mineral deposition all disclosed greatly accelerated adhesion, proliferation and osteo-differentiation of human mesenchymal stem cells (hMSCs) on the pep-CMC-CFRPEEK/n-HA biocomposite due to the additive effect of the CMC polysaccharide and the small osteoinductive peptide. More importantly, in vivo evaluation of the beagle tibia model by means of micro-CT, histological analysis, SEM observation and fluorescent labeling confirmed the remarkably boosted bioactivity and osteointegration. The CFRPEEK/n-HA ternary composite with the dual functions of bacterial adhesion reduction and osteointegration promotion holds great potential as a bioactive implant material in orthopedic/dental applications based on this scheme.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决CFRPEEK植入体的骨整合不足和感染风险。
summary_zh.method: 在CFRPEEK/n-HA表面共价接枝羧甲基壳聚糖和骨形成肽。
summary_zh.result: 显著促进hMSC的黏附和成骨分化，并在动物模型中证实骨整合增强。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和比格犬胫骨模型体内实验。

summary_en.motivation: To improve osseointegration and reduce infection risk of CFRPEEK implants.
summary_en.method: Covalent grafting of carboxymethyl chitosan and bone-forming peptide onto CFRPEEK/n-HA composite.
summary_en.result: Enhanced hMSC adhesion, osteogenic differentiation, and in vivo osseointegration in a beagle tibia model.
summary_en.validation: In vitro assays and in vivo animal study.
